events.text: The Swedish Navy began using Hårsfjärden as a training area.
events.subject: self
events.quote: In the late 1800s , the Swedish Navy began using Hårsfjärden as a training area

events.text: Hårsfjärden began to be used more permanently as a base for the Coastal Fleets combat and signal schools and for naval mine training.
events.subject: self
events.quote: From 1904 , Hårsfjärden began to be used more permanently as a base

events.text: It was decided to set up a target depot for a combat school at Vitsgarn.
events.subject: self
events.quote: In 1905 it was decided to set up a target depot for a combat school at Vitsgarn

events.text: The Swedish state began gradually acquiring more land for the navy, including at western Vitsgarn.
events.subject: self
events.quote: From 1911 to 1921 , the Swedish state gradually acquired more land for the navy

events.text: The Swedish state's gradual acquisition of more land for the navy ended.
events.subject: self
events.quote: From 1911 to 1921 , the Swedish state gradually acquired more land for the navy

events.text: The Riksdag decided that the Swedish state would acquire Berga Castle.
events.subject: self
events.quote: In 1944 , the Riksdag decided that the Swedish state would acquire Berga Castle

events.text: The Berga Naval Training Schools started operating as the Swedish Navy Non-Commissioned Officers School (MUOS).
events.subject: self
events.quote: The Berga Naval Training Schools started operating in 1946 , then as the Swedish Navy Non-Commissioned Officers School

events.text: Operations at Berga Naval Training Schools began with teaching in the Non-Commissioned Officers Schools chief mate and machinist programs.
events.subject: self
events.quote: On 1 July 1946 , operations at Berga Naval Training Schools began with teaching

events.text: The craftsmanship, economy and coastal artillery programs began.
events.subject: self
events.quote: the craftsmanship , economy and coastal artillery programs began on 1 October

events.text: Crown Prince Gustaf Adolf performed the inauguration of the Swedish Navy Non-Commissioned Officers School.
events.subject: self
events.quote: On 21 October 1946 , His Royal Highness Crown Prince Gustaf Adolf performed the inauguration

events.text: Construction began on a facility for training in torpedo and submarine service.
events.subject: self
events.quote: In the summer of 1949 , construction began on a facility for training in torpedo and submarine service

events.text: The Submarine and ASW School began training at Berga for both commanders and conscripts.
events.subject: self
events.quote: In 1948–1949 , the Submarine and ASW School ( Ubåts- och ubåtsjaktskolan ) began training at Berga

events.text: Following the Defence Act of 2004, Berga Naval Base became the training ground for the 1st Marine Regiment and the location of the Home Guard unit Södertörn Group.
events.subject: self
events.quote: Following the Defence Act of 2004 , Berga Naval Base is the training ground for the 1st Marine Regiment

events.text: The navy returned in the form of the 4th Naval Warfare Flotilla.
events.subject: self
events.quote: From autumn 2008 the navy has also returned in the form of the 4th Naval Warfare Flotilla .

events.text: The Swedish Naval Schools was disbanded and replaced by the Swedish Naval Warfare Centre.
events.subject: self
events.quote: the Swedish Naval Schools ( Örlogsskolorna , ÖS ) was disbanded and replaced by the Swedish Naval Warfare Centre
